---
applyTo: "app/**/*.ts,app/**/*.tsx,src/**/*.ts,src/**/*.tsx,components/**/*.ts,components/**/*.tsx,next.config.*,package.json"
---

# Next.js / TypeScript instructions

- Prefer the repository's current routing and rendering conventions.
- Default to server components when the current architecture supports them.
- Keep client-only code explicit.
- Reuse existing UI, state, fetch, and validation patterns before introducing new ones.
